name: i18n
description: next-intl with locale-prefixed routing, message catalogs, and middleware
postInstall:
Manual edits required — see recipes/i18n/README.md for the full walkthrough.

Summary:
  1. Move src/app/(frontend)/{layout,page}.tsx and any other frontend routes under src/app/[locale]/(frontend)/
  2. Wrap layout.tsx with NextIntlClientProvider and call setRequestLocale(locale)
  3. Register the middleware in src/proxy.ts (already copied) and re-export from src/middleware.ts if you have one
  4. Update next.config.ts: const withNextIntl = createNextIntlPlugin(); export default withNextIntl(nextConfig)

Locales default to ['en', 'pt'] — edit src/i18n/routing.ts to change.
